name: sciblox
description: An offline educational heredity adventure for Android and iOS

scripts.test: node --test tests/state.test.mjs tests/local-multiplayer.test.mjs tests/three-models.test.mjs tests/station-upgrade.test.mjs tests/i18n.test.mjs tests/guide.test.mjs tests/classroom-coop.test.mjs tests/camera-stability.test.mjs && playwright test
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && node scripts/android-build.mjs debug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && node scripts/android-build.mjs bundle
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
